description: Add nifty-oss asset support for portfolio display and staking. CRITICAL: Use @solana/kit ONLY - NEVER use @solana/web3.js for new code.

userStories.title: Fetch nifty-oss asset IDL from GitHub
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the nifty-oss asset program IDL to generate a type-safe SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: Update packages/solana-programs/scripts/fetch-idls.ts to add nifty-oss IDL source

userStories.title: Generate nifty-oss SDK with Codama
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a generated SDK to decode and interact with nifty-oss assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Export asset SDK from packages/solana-programs/src/index.ts: export * as asset from './generated/asset'
userStories.notes: Patched fetch-idls.ts to add missing type definitions (Standard, DelegateRole, ExtensionType) since the upstream nifty-oss IDL is incomplete. Fixed stake SDK export conflicts for isolatedModules.

userStories.title: Create nifty asset fetching service in API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a backend service to fetch nifty-oss assets by wallet address.
acceptanceCriteria: Use @solana/kit for RPC calls (getProgramAccounts with owner filter)
Use generated asset SDK to decode account data
Return assets with metadata: mint, name, image (from uri), group (collection)
userStories.notes: Implemented manual decoder for nifty-oss asset account structure since Codama only generates instructions, not account decoders. Parses 168-byte base structure plus Metadata and Attributes extensions.

userStories.title: Fetch nifty collection metadata
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fetch collection metadata for nifty assets to display collection info.
acceptanceCriteria: Use fetchMultipleAccounts with batching to avoid rate limits
Decode collection assets using generated SDK
Return collection name, image from metadata URI
Handle ungrouped assets (no group field) gracefully
userStories.notes: Implemented fetchNiftyCollections using getMultipleAccounts with batch size 100. Reuses existing decodeNiftyAsset decoder. Returns Map<address, NiftyCollection> with name, image (from uri), and symbol.

userStories.title: Add nifty assets to NFT fetching endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my nifty-oss assets alongside my other NFTs.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch DAS assets and nifty assets in parallel using Promise.all
Map nifty assets to match DAS response format with tokenStandard: 6
Merge nifty collections into collections array
Ungrouped nifty assets go to 'Ungrouped' collection (same as DAS)
userStories.notes: Added 'Nifty' to TokenStandard type in both API and frontend. Fetches DAS and nifty assets in parallel, maps nifty assets to DAS format, merges collections with proper count handling. Ungrouped nifty assets have collectionId: null like DAS.

userStories.title: Add Nifty badge to NFT cards
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which NFTs are nifty-oss assets with a badge indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: Badge positioned similar to existing badges (e.g., Staked badge)
Use subtle styling consistent with design system
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added Nifty badge in bottom-left position (same as Staked badge, shows when not staked). Uses violet-500 color for distinction. Updated nft-grid.tsx (not nft-card.tsx - card is inline component). TokenStandard is string 'Nifty' not number 6.

userStories.title: Add NIFTY_PROGRAM_ID constant to staking hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the nifty program ID available for building stake transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Follow existing constant patterns in the file
userStories.notes: Added both constants following existing PublicKey pattern in use-staking.ts

userStories.title: Implement buildStakeNiftyInstructions function
userStories.description: As a user, I want to stake my nifty Dandies NFTs.
acceptanceCriteria: Required accounts: staker, collection, nftRecord, stakeRecord, programConfig, asset, nftAuthority, signer, feesWallet, systemProgram, niftyProgram
Follow existing buildStakeCoreInstructions pattern for PDA derivation
Use codamaInstructionToWeb3 helper to convert instruction
userStories.notes: systemProgram defaults automatically in Codama SDK. Added BuildStakeNiftyInstructionsInput and buildStakeNiftyInstructions following Core pattern.

userStories.title: Implement buildUnstakeNiftyInstructions function
userStories.description: As a user, I want to unstake my nifty Dandies NFTs.
acceptanceCriteria: Required accounts: programConfig, staker, collection, stakeRecord, nftRecord?, rewardMint?, stakeTokenVault?, rewardReceiveAccount?, nftMint, collectionMint, feesWallet, tokenAuthority?, nftAuthority, owner, tokenProgram, associatedTokenProgram, systemProgram, niftyProgram
Handle token emissions same as buildUnstakeCoreInstructions
Add emission accounts as remaining accounts
userStories.notes: Copied buildUnstakeCoreInstructions pattern exactly, changed coreProgram to niftyProgram using NIFTY_PROGRAM_ID. tokenProgram and systemProgram default automatically in Codama SDK.

userStories.title: Add isNiftyAsset helper function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to detect nifty assets to use correct staking instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add isNiftyAsset(nft: NFT): boolean helper to apps/web/src/hooks/use-staking.ts
Returns true if isNiftyAsset AND nft.collection === DANDIES_NIFTY_COLLECTION
userStories.notes: TokenStandard is 'Nifty' string, not number 6. Uses nft.collectionId (not nft.collection) to compare with DANDIES_NIFTY_COLLECTION.toBase58().

userStories.title: Update stake page to show nifty Dandies as available
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my nifty Dandies in the 'Available to Stake' section.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter available NFTs to include nifty Dandies (tokenStandard === 6 AND collection matches)
Show Nifty badge on nifty assets in stake grid
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Updated AvailableToStakeGrid.tsx (not stake.tsx) - filter logic is in the grid component. Added DANDIES_NIFTY_COLLECTION_ID to OR filter. Added Nifty badge using isNiftyAsset helper.

userStories.title: Wire up stake button for nifty assets
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click Stake on a nifty Dandy and have it use the correct instruction.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect if asset is nifty using isNiftyAsset helper
Call buildStakeCoreInstructions for Core assets (existing behavior)
Transaction succeeds and NFT moves to staked section

userStories.notes: Updated StakeDialog.tsx and BulkStakeDialog.tsx (not stake.tsx - handler just opens dialog). Uses ternary with isNiftyAsset() to select instruction builder. Note: pNFT staking uses buildStakeInstructions, not buildStakeCoreInstructions.
